gui.nickpaints.tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to NickPaints!
gui.nickpaints.tutorial.welcome.content: This short tour will guide you through the main features. Click 'Start Tour' to begin.
gui.nickpaints.tutorial.step1.title: 1. Main Configuration Window
gui.nickpaints.tutorial.step1.content:
This is where you create your gradient!

- Preview: See your nickname live.
- Colors: Add, remove, and pick colors for the gradient.
- Options: Control animation speed, style, and direction.
gui.nickpaints.tutorial.step2.title: 2. Settings Window
gui.nickpaints.tutorial.step2.content:
This window controls how the mod behaves.

- Toggles: Enable/disable rendering globally or for your own nametag.
- Disable Player: Stop seeing the paint of specific players.
- Clear Cache: Refresh all paints if they seem outdated.
gui.nickpaints.tutorial.step3.title: 3. Save & Sync
gui.nickpaints.tutorial.step3.content:
This is the most important button!

Click 'Save & Sync' to apply your changes and upload your paint for other players to see.
